statement: Let $n \geq 0$ be an integer and $a_0, a_1, \ldots, a_n$ real numbers. Show that there exists $k \in \{0, 1, \ldots, n\}$ such that $a_0 + a_1 x + \cdots + a_n x^n \leq a_0 + a_1 + \cdots + a_k$ for all $x \in [0,1]$.

$n$ ants walk along a line at constant nonzero speeds. When two or more ants collide, they all instantly reverse direction. Assuming the total number of collisions is finite, determine the largest possible number of collisions in terms of $n$.

Let $ABC$ be a scalene acute triangle. Let $B_1$ on ray $AC$ satisfy $|AB_1| = |BB_1|$, and $C_1$ on ray $AB$ satisfy $|AC_1| = |CC_1|$. Let $B_2$ and $C_2$ be points on line $BC$ with $|AB_2| = |CB_2|$ and $|BC_2| = |AC_2|$. Prove that $B_1, C_1, B_2, C_2$ are concyclic.

A subset $A \subseteq \mathbb{N} = \{0,1,2,\ldots\}$ is 	extit{good} if every integer $n > 0$ has at most one prime divisor $p$ with $n - p \in A$.

a) Show that the set of perfect squares $S = \{0,1,4,9,\ldots\}$ is good.

b) Find an infinite good set disjoint from $S$.
